title: Reverse a linked list
summary: Walk the list once, turning each node's arrow around to point at the part already reversed.

narration.text: Nothing is reversed yet, so the reversed part is empty.
Start at the head of the list.
There's still a node to handle: the one holding {curr.val}.
No nodes left: everything has been reversed.
Remember what comes after {curr.val}: nothing, it's the last node.
Remember what comes after {curr.val}: the node holding {nxt.val}. Otherwise we'd lose it.
Turn the arrow around: {curr.val} now points back at the reversed part.
The reversed part now starts at {prev.val}.
Move on to the rest of the list.
The list was empty, so the reversed list is empty too.
The reversed list starts at {prev.val}, the old last node.
